get.description:
This API endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve information about DMA lead generation forms. The request URL is `{{baseUrl}}/dmaLeadGenForm` with a query parameter `ids` that takes a list of lead generation form URNs.

### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| owner | String | The URN of the organization |
| leadGenFormID | String | The ID of the leadGenForm |
| q | String | The query parameter "owner" |

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| results | Object | A dictionary containing the information about the lead generation forms. |
| results.{form_urn} | Object | Information about a specific lead generation form identified by its URN. |
| results.{form_urn}.owner | String | The owner of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.hiddenFields | Array | A list of hidden fields in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.versionId | Integer | The version ID of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.created | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was created. |
| results.{form_urn}.creationLocale | Object | The locale (country and language) in which the lead generation form was created. |
| results.{form_urn}.name | String | The name of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.id | Integer | The ID of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.lastModified | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was last modified. |
| results.{form_urn}.state | String | The state of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content | Object | The content of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions | Array | A list of questions in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].name | String | The name of a question in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails | Object | Details about a question in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails | Object | Details specific to a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails.options | Array | A list of options for a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails.options\[\].text | String | The text of an option for a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.description | String | The description of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo | Object | Information about the legal aspects of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents | Array | A list of consents required by the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents\[\].consent | Object | Information about a consent required by the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents\[\].checkRequired | Boolean | Indicates whether the consent is required to submit the form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.privacyPolicyUrl | String | The URL to the privacy policy associated with the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.legalDisclaimer | Object | The legal disclaimer associated with the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.headline | String | The headline of the lead generation form. |
| statuses | Object | A dictionary containing the statuses of the lead generation forms. |
| statuses.{form_urn} | Integer | The status of a specific lead generation form identified by its URN. |
| errors | Object | A dictionary containing any errors that occurred during the request. |

Please note that the actual values of the fields may vary and have been omitted in this description for brevity.

This endpoint allows developers to retrieve information about a specific versioned lead generation form.

#### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | Integer | The unique identifier of the lead generation form |

#### Response Fields

In the event of a successful request, the response will contain the following fields:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| owner | String | The owner of the lead generation form |
| hiddenFields | Array | An array of hidden fields, each containing a name and value |
| versionId | Integer | The version ID of the lead generation form |
| created | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was created |
| creationLocale | Object | An object containing the country and language of the lead generation form |
| name | String | The name of the lead generation form |
| id | Integer | The unique identifier of the lead generation form |
| lastModified | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was last modified |
| state | String | The current state of the lead generation form |
| content | Object | An object containing the content of the lead generation form, including questions, description, legal information, and headline |

The 'content' object contains the following fields:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| questions | Array | An array of questions, each containing a question ID, localized question text, response editability, name, question details, and predefined field |
| description | Object | An object containing the localized description of the lead generation form |
| legalInfo | Object | An object containing consents, legal information ID, privacy policy URL, and legal disclaimer |
| headline | Object | An object containing the localized headline of the lead generation form |

Each question object in the 'questions' array contains the following fields:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| questionId | Integer | The question ID |
| question | Object | An object containing the localized question text |
| responseEditable | Boolean | Indicates whether the response is editable |
| name | String | The name of the question |
| questionDetails | Object | An object containing details about the question, such as max response length |
| predefinedField | String | The predefined field of the question |
| responseRequired | Boolean | Indicates whether a response is required |

The 'legalInfo' object contains the following fields:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| consents | Array | An array of consents, each containing a consent object with localized consent text and check requirement |
| legalInfoId | Integer | The legal information ID |
| privacyPolicyUrl | String | The URL of the privacy policy |
| legalDisclaimer | Object | An object containing the localized legal disclaimer |

In the event of an error, the response will contain an empty object.
